name: Typha
look_here_first: Confirm the upper staminate and lower pistillate spike zones. On an intact flowering stem, measure the naked gap; then check the inner sheath and first 1–10 cm of the leaf blade for glands. Confirm bracteoles and stigma shape under magnification when characters conflict.
shared_genus_traits: Rhizomatous marsh herbs with long linear leaves.
Upper staminate and lower pistillate cylindrical spike zones.

species_comparison_matrix.caution: Overlap at 24–25 mm; measure mature spikes.

cautions: Hybridization, spike damage and leaf plasticity make any single character unreliable.
Technical bracteole/gland confirmation belongs to diagnostic review.
lookalikes: Schoenoplectus: branched sedge spikelets, not two vertically separated cattail spike zones.
diagnostic_photo_checklist: Matched intact flowering stalks with centimeter ruler and male/female arrows
Paired pistillate flower dissections at 20–30× showing bracteoles and stigma shape with scale
handoff: Approved Taxa Installer owns species; Diagnostic Photo Polish owns photos.
